issues.title: Inline modal container obscures main table view
issues.description: The dialog layout container is embedded directly over the lower section of the file list, blocking table content.
issues.evidence: A large dark container holding the storage dialog occupies the bottom half of the file listing area.
issues.suggestion: Render the dialog inside a standard overlay portal or modal backdrop instead of interrupting inline content flow.
issues.triageNote: The dark container over the file list on pair-100 is the page's own ds:Dialog storage dialog embedded open-in-place (deliberate non-modal clipped-frame pattern); DialogLayout's usage there is the framed right-rail preview panel and does not touch the table — the flaw is page composition, not the component.

issues.title: Illegible header text contrast
issues.description: The dialog title lacks sufficient contrast against the white dialog background.
issues.evidence: The 'Switch to Pro?' header is rendered in light text against a white background, making it nearly invisible.
issues.suggestion: Apply dark text color tokens to match the light surface.
issues.triageNote: Confirmed in source: the panel inherited from Dialog.Content hardcodes bg-[#ffffff]/border-[#e5e5e5] while the title uses text-default-font (near-white in dark); fixed by overriding the DialogLayout panel with bg-panel/border-default-border tokens.

issues.title: Uneven column alignment in dialog body
issues.description: The left profile column and right textual content have mismatched vertical baselines.
issues.evidence: The user badge column sits awkwardly high relative to the main heading and body copy.
issues.suggestion: Align the left profile column vertically with the primary dialog content block.
issues.triageNote: Real: the row top-aligned the leading mark column (demo's own pt-1 nudge pattern), leaving the short mark column pinned high beside the taller title/body/actions column; fixed by centering the row (items-center) and removing the pt-1 pattern from the demo.
